minimal_next_comparison.first_prerequisite: Close the existing current ordinary-flow acceptance gates without changing original failed results.
minimal_next_comparison.first_performance_pair: One predeclared finite connected-idle pass per exact current and shipped reference app on the same Mac/OS and real peer, e.g.60s, same GUI/role/TLS/discovery/polling/process set; raw timed CPU and sampled whole-stack RSS plus independent exits and cleanup.
minimal_next_comparison.failure_rule: Keep both outcomes; stop at failed prerequisites; no retry, alternate port, SO_REUSE, platform substitution or selecting a better run.
minimal_next_comparison.claim_limit: One pair supports only scoped observations; distribution, launch, physical input, clipboard, reconnect and endurance require separate predeclared comparisons.
